title: Artifact for "Limits of Metamorphic Testing for Object-Level Authorization: Temporal Reachability, Oracle Admissibility, and Measurement Resolution"
description: Reproducibility artifact accompanying the JISA submission. It contains (i) the raw experimental records (scenario/configuration study, real-system cell study across Gitea 1.22.6 / Gogs 0.14.3 / GitLab 17.11.7, execution of the published relations on the native engine, and a seeded positive control); (ii) the analysis pipeline that recomputes every number, table and figure in the paper from those records; and (iii) the LaTeX manuscript source. Running `bash reproduce.sh` regenerates all outputs and the PDF; `bash verify_artifact.sh` asserts SHA-256 integrity of every raw record and byte-reproducible output. No number in the paper is hand-typed; all figures are vector (no AI-generated pixels).
notes: The tag `artifact-v1` is re-anchored to the camera-ready / submission commit. The DOI minted by Zenodo should be cited in the paper's Data availability statement. Licence is adjustable by the authors (see ZENODO_GUIDE.md).
